lines.text: Hello both. Three weeks since the new hip, how's it going?
Since last time I'm moving a bit better, I've ditched one crutch indoors.
He's been up and down the stairs on his own, I just hover behind him.
That's perfect, stay behind him going down.
Since last time the wound's had a bit of clear ooze at the bottom end, though I could be imagining it.
Let me have a look. It's dry today and the edges are knitting together nicely.
The discharge sheet says enoxaparin 40 milligrams once a day for another three weeks, so keep going with those injections.
I do them for him, every evening at six.
No lifting anything heavier than a kettle, and don't bend the hip past a right angle for the first six weeks.
If the calf goes hot, red or swollen, or you get breathless, phone 111 the same day.
